meta.docSubtitle: 22 flows · Celigo → MuleSoft migration · Most answers are pre-filled — please verify and correct

bizContext.snapshot: Homage is a Columbus, OH DTC licensed-apparel brand (~$30–35M ARV) selling NFL, NBA, and pop-culture gear on Shopify Plus with NetSuite as the ERP. 22+ integration flows are currently managed by Sikich via Celigo. DataSkate replaces the Celigo layer — same operational model, better platform — with a clear path to AI automation in Year 2. Most answers in this form are already filled in from your briefing. Your job is to confirm they are correct and fill in the blanks we genuinely couldn't know.

journeyCards.label: Phase 1 — Connected
journeyCards.headline: All 22 Celigo flows on MuleSoft
journeyCards.body: Every current Celigo integration migrated, tested, and running on MuleSoft CloudHub 2.0. Same operational reliability — no Sikich dependency. Celigo fully decommissioned.

journeyCards.label: Phase 2 — Automated
journeyCards.headline: CSWOS inventory intelligence
journeyCards.body: Automated sell-through logic drives Shopify inventory policy from real-time NetSuite data. No manual threshold management — rules enforce themselves.

journeyCards.label: Phase 3 — Agentic
journeyCards.headline: SKU Velocity Agent
journeyCards.body: AI agent monitors sell-through rates, EDI demand, and restock lead times — surfaces margin risk 72 hours before a stockout. Built on the data layer from Phase 1.

p0Blockers.title: Celigo Flow Inventory Spreadsheet
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Request from Sikich immediately. DataSkate needs this to confirm the 23rd flow and lock final pricing. Ask your Sikich account manager for a full export of all active Celigo flows (bundle with the credentials call below).

p0Blockers.title: NetSuite TBA Credentials (via Sikich)
p0Blockers.clientAction: — 5 credentials required before development begins: accountId, consumerKey, consumerSecret, tokenId, tokenSecret. Sikich provisions these — schedule that call first.

p0Blockers.title: Shopify Custom App + Access Token
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Go to Shopify Admin → Settings → Apps → Develop Apps → Create App. Private Apps are deprecated. Required scopes: read/write orders, inventory, products, customers, fulfillments. DataSkate will walk you through this if needed.

UC1a

▼

3

⚠️ CRITICAL — NetSuite: single subsidiary or OneWorld (multi-subsidiary)?A missing subsidiary value causes every NetSuite write to fail.

In ScopeShopify webhook → classify by payment/customer type → create NetSuite Cash Sale with line items, tax, and payment info
Assumes Pre-existsNetSuite Cash Sale record type active; item internalId cross-reference table available; Shopify Custom App credentialed
Out of ScopeNetSuite SuiteScript development; Chart of Accounts config; Shopify storefront changes

internalFlags.bodyHtml:
FLAG-1 — HIGH — NetSuite / UC9
Invoice creation mechanism unconfirmed. NetSuite invoices are system-generated — MuleSoft cannot POST to create invoices directly. Kailash must confirm with Sikich whether UC9 is a SuiteScript-triggered billing workflow, an SO status update only, or fully NetSuite-internal (descope candidate).
FLAG-2 — HIGH — Shopify Plus / UC5
Shopify connector v1.1 GraphQL coverage for bulk product mutations needs verification before UC5 development. If connector doesn't support productCreate with variants + metafields via GraphQL, implement via HTTP connector + Shopify GraphQL endpoint directly.
FLAG-3 — MEDIUM — Cross-system
Shopify variant ID ↔ NetSuite item internalId cross-reference table is a prerequisite for UC4 and UC5. Not a MuleSoft deliverable — must coordinate with Sikich in the first setup call.
FLAG-4 — HIGH — Celigo Migration
Celigo custom JS transforms (pre-map, post-response, post-submit hooks) must be extracted and documented per flow before DataWeave porting. Sikich holds this knowledge — make this a Day 1 request.
FLAG-5 — MEDIUM — Laravel/Vapor API Gateway
Scope boundary unresolved. If MuleSoft integrates WITH the gateway (needs its API contract); if MuleSoft REPLACES some gateway functions (significant re-scoping). Clarify in scoping call.
FLAG-6 — MEDIUM — Competitive
Homage is evaluating 3–4 vendors. Celigo flow inventory spreadsheet is the single most critical missing artifact. Bundle this request with the Sikich credentials call to show operational readiness.
FLAG-7 — MEDIUM — Buyer Profile
Operational Pragmatist. Ivy probe: ask "Once you've finished your vendor conversations, how does the final decision typically work — is this yours to make, or does it need sign-off from a broader team?" Natural in a vendor eval context; surfaces approval chain without telegraphing intent.
